loraValidate.title: LoRA training corpus validator
loraValidate.description: Check whether your audio clips are ready to fine-tune an ACE-Step LoRA. Drop a folder of .wav / .flac / .mp3 files (plus optional .txt lyric sidecars with the same basename) and we'll run the same checks the local training script enforces: sample-rate ≥ 16 kHz, 1–2 channels, 10–300 s per clip, and a non-empty lyrics file for vocal training.
